violated_contract: A concurrency test must observe the ownership and committed-result contract directly. Aggregating transaction retries per shard does not measure simultaneous owners: one correctly fenced transaction can retry repeatedly against concurrent admission, while a missing fence can succeed without any retries.
canonical_prevention: Exercise real conditional claim acquisition with competing clients and observe the production transaction's existing matching-token read before any data access or write, without adding reads or serializing the test. Retain unique durable lease assertions and failure signals. Keep retry totals diagnostic, and discriminate with a fenced pull that aborts twice plus an unclaimed pull rejected by the observer. Invalidate an acquired claim by takeover or unchanged-token expiry and require no lease or job/control/claim mutation by the rejected pull.
